newsitem.title: INDIA: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, June 24, Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk 8-10 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 9 to discharge, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Floating crane Shravan laid up from 5/8 for indefinite period. Floating crane Shreshta laid up for annual inspection mid-July for indefinite period. Calcutta - 29 Vessels due of which 3 coking coal, 8 product tankers, 7 containers, 1 crude, 2 coal, 1 log, 1 limestone, 1 sulphur, 1 steel pipes, 1 steel, 1 rock phosphate, 1 lash barge, 1 peas. 9 Loading at berth, 25 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - 10 Due, up to 1 day delay. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 General cargo at CSL jetty and 1 naval vessel in drydock.

Madras - 24 Vessels due of which 6 coal, 2 general cargo, 4 fertiliser, 3 iron ore, 7 containers, 1 quartz, 2 oil. Delays expected, coal/coke/others 2-3 days, fertiliser/scrap 5-6 days. 3 Loading at berth. 11 Discharging, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - Five ore vessels due, 4-5 days delay. 1 Alumina, 1 MSD due, no delays. 1 Fuel oil due, 2-3 days delay. 1 Phosphoric acid due, no delays. 3 Waiting at anchorage to load, 3 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - 16 Vessels due. 10-12 days delay expected. 7 Loading at berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 discharging at berth, 11 discharging at stream. 2 In harbour, 3 tankers, 10 waiting.

Mangalore - 13 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay. 6 Loading/discharging at berth, 1 awaiting berth, 1 other vessel. Jawaharlal Nehru - Vessels due, 1 fertiliser, 5 tankers/iron ore. Delays, urea 15-18 days, other fertiliser 25-30 days, tankers/iron ore 10-12 days. 1 Tanker loading at berth, 2 fertiliser/raw material/foodgrain discharging at berth, 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage. 4 Tankers/iron ore waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 fertiliser/raw material/foodgrain waiting to discharge. Bulk berth 4 not available from 1/6 to 30/9. Heavy rain. Paradip - Two vessels due, 6-7 days delay. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge.

Tuticorin - 11 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay. 3 Loading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 7 discharging at berth, 1 at anchorage. 1 Waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. Visakhapatnam - 13 Vessels due, 10-15 days delay expected. 7 Loading at berth, 8 discharging, 16 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth. 12 At anchorage to load at inner harbour berth.

PAKISTAN, June 23 - Karachi - Three vessels due. Delays expected up to 1 day for general cargo/container vessels, 3 days for tankers. 4 Vessels loading at berth. 2 Container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 7 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, sugar, hsd, chemicals). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load SOUTH KOREA, June 24 - Inchon - 67

Vessels in port (40 berthed, 27 anchored) of which 6 general cargo, 5 containers, 4 each logs, coil, 3 each corn, steel, 2 each pig iron, soy, cars, 1 each molasses, copra, raw sugar, ingots, pulp, plywood, wheat, scrap, soymeal. Anchored, 5 each corn, cars, 3 logs, 2 each general cargo, pulp, containers, 1 each wheat, pig iron, plywood, bananas, scrap, copra, coils, talc. 1-2 Days berthing delay. Busan - 154 Vessels in port (47 berthed, 107 anchored including 53 laid up) of which 32 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 54 Awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days berthing delay. Pohang - 22 In port (17 berthed, 5 anchored) of which discharging 4 steel, 2 iron ore, 1 each coal, steel scrap, silicon, manganese ore, logs. 6 Loading steel, 5 waiting, 1-2 days delay. Ulsan - 23 Vessels berthed of which discharging 3 feedmeal, 2 monoethylglycol, 1 each methanol, acetic acid, propylene, vinyl chloride monomer, sugar, corn, propane, crude oil. Loading, 4 chemicals, 3 genera

SRI LANKA, June 24 - Colombo - Vessels due, 6 container/feeders, 1 ro/ro. Delays, general cargo 2-3 days, container (feeders) 24 hours. Loading at berth, 4 essential services, 10 containers, 2 general cargo. Discharging at berth, 2 bagged sugar, 10 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged urea, 1 bagged mop, 1 bulk clinker, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk cement. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 7 containers (feeders), 1 bagged sugar, 2 bagged cement, 1 bagged soya, 2 ro/ro, 1 bagged urea. 3 Vessels bunkering, 1 in drydock, 6 others, 5 awaiting orders, 1 crew change. Berthing/unberthing delays (pilotage) on breakbulk conventional vessels. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - No vessels in port.
